text: Outside the offices of India's market regulator, the trucks start to arrive.
Not one or two. A hundred and twenty-seven of them.
And inside the cartons, paper. Application forms. Receipts. Names.
Every name is supposed to be a person who handed over their savings to one company.
And together, those savings come to more than twenty-four thousand crore rupees. Billions of dollars.
The regulator has one job now.
Find these people. Give them their money back.
Some of them may not be there to find.
What follows would take one of India's most famous men from a palace… to a prison… and leave a fortune sitting in an account, waiting for people nobody can find.
This is the paper trail. Case four. Three Crore Names.
